dependency_review.material_risk: 1700681 itself depends on afterok:1690935; if a variable element fails, replay can remain DependencyNeverSatisfied and a further afterany dependency on replay can block supervised work indefinitely.
dependency_review.why_safe: The supervised array remains ineligible until every variable element terminates regardless of result. Thereafter, the maximum possible overlap is control %1 plus replay 1 plus supervised %1.
dependency_review.existing_priority_preservation: No existing job was modified; controls and replay were submitted earlier and retain scheduler priority.
dependency_review.failure_behavior: A failed variable element still releases the supervised afterany dependency while replay may remain unsatisfied; there is no dependency cycle or indefinite replay coupling.

resource_admission.automatic_requeue_override: --no-requeue added at submission because the immutable launcher has resume disabled and refuses an existing seed directory
resource_admission.recovery_boundary: preemption, timeout, or failure requires deliberate checkpoint-aware review; do not assume automatic resume

global_ledger_at_admission.orchestration_ceiling: 3 concurrent GPU allocations and 384G requested host memory
global_ledger_at_admission.before_variable_termination: supervised dependency blocks it; existing R2f %2 plus control %1 remains at most 3 GPUs/384G
global_ledger_at_admission.after_successful_variable_termination: control %1 (128G) plus replay 1 (128G) plus supervised %1 (32G) = at most 3 GPUs/288G
global_ledger_at_admission.after_unsuccessful_variable_termination: replay may remain dependency-unsatisfied; control %1 plus supervised %1 = at most 2 GPUs/160G

stop_conditions.on_failure_or_timeout: preserve artifacts and review a checkpoint-aware recovery before any new scheduler action
stop_conditions.after_six_endpoints: run the preregistered validation/convergence/behavior analysis before deciding the conditional all-six HLVid gate
